items.title: Urban vegetation experienced less damage than rural vegetation during the 2022 compound hot–dry event in eastern China
items.title_en: Urban vegetation experienced less damage than rural vegetation during the 2022 compound hot–dry event in eastern China
items.title_zh: 在2022年中国东部发生的复合性干热事件期间，城市植被遭受的损害程度小于农村植被
items.summary_en: Compound hot–dry events (CHDEs) increasingly threaten vegetation growth, but whether urban environments amplify or buffer vegetation responses to such extremes remains unclear. This study examined urban–rural contrasts in vegetation responses by integrating standardized enhanced vegetation index (EVI) anomalies with resistance and recovery metrics during the 2022 CHDE over the Yangtze River Basin (YZB) in China. Our results show that the CHDE caused widespread declines in EVI across the YZB, but urban vegetation showed weaker declines than rural vegetation and croplands, together with a smaller damaged area and higher resistance among affected pixels. By contrast, post-event recovery showed little difference among land-use types. This indicates that the lower decline of urban vegetation during the CHDE was mainly associated with reduced damage during the stress period rather than enhanced recovery after stress. Urban–rural differences were associated with several climatic, environmental, and urbanization-related factors. Our findings highlight the need to explicitly consider urban vegetation in compound climate-extreme impact assessments and to strengthen adaptive management under intensifying heat and water stress.
items.summary_zh: 复合型干热事件（CHDE）对植被生长构成的威胁日益加剧，但城市环境究竟会放大还是缓冲植被对这类极端事件的响应，目前尚不明确。 本研究通过整合2022年中国长江流域（YZB）复合热干事件期间标准化增强植被指数（EVI）的异常值与抗性和恢复指标，考察了城乡植被响应的差异。 研究结果表明，复合干热事件导致长江流域（YZB）范围内EVI普遍下降，但城市植被的下降幅度小于农村植被和农田，受影响像元中的受损面积较小，抗逆性也更高。 相比之下，事件后的恢复情况在不同土地利用类型之间差异不大。这表明，城市植被在此次极端高温干旱事件期间下降幅度较小，主要与应激期受损程度较低有关，而非应激后恢复能力更强。城乡差异与若干气候、环境及城市化相关因素有关。 我们的研究结果强调，在复合气候极端事件影响评估中，有必要明确将城市植被纳入考量，并在日益加剧的热应力和水应力背景下加强适应性管理。

items.title: Reduced summer carbon dioxide efflux from semi-arid agrivoltaic compared to conventional horticultural soil
items.title_en: Reduced summer carbon dioxide efflux from semi-arid agrivoltaic compared to conventional horticultural soil
items.title_zh: 与传统园艺土壤相比，半干旱地区农光互补系统的夏季二氧化碳排放量有所减少
items.summary_en: Agrivoltaic (AV) systems that combine horticultural crops with photovoltaic (PV) infrastructure on the same land parcel can provide mutual benefits for crop performance, electricity production, and water use in semi-arid climates. Whether semi-arid AV systems provide additional benefits for soil development and carbon (C) accumulation remains unclear. Larger aboveground biomass and yield production, which has been observed in semi-arid AV for certain crops, may accelerate C loss by supporting more continual and extensive microbial and root respiration, resulting in net zero or negative change in soil C over a growing season. Alternatively, AV systems may retain more soil C by reducing stress-induced respiration. To test these contrasting hypotheses, we compared crop biomass and yield, soil carbon pools, and semi-continuous microclimate and respired carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions for two horticultural crops grown in an experimental AV site in southern Arizona, USA. Over one summer growing season, we observed an approximately 9% reduction in daily mean soil CO2 efflux from legume (cowpea, Vigna unguiculata) and 48% reduction from aromatic herb (basil, Ocimum basilicum) beds, with the strongest impacts of AV appearing during the early monsoon season when plants were mature. On diel timescales, AV soil CO2 efflux peaked later in the day compared to conventional horticultural beds, corresponding to lagged increases in soil temperature under solar panels. Smaller CO2 efflux in AV coincided with a doubling of aboveground crop biomass. Both crops and cover types experienced similar declines in soil C over the growing season, indicating that reduced CO2 efflux did not correspond to a measurable increase in soil C during this period and highlighting the need to resolve other C transformation and loss pathways. Complementing its well-described food-water-energy benefits, we find potential for AV to reduce soil CO2 efflux and urge future research to identify changes to soil C cycling that result from the addition of PV to horticultural landscapes.
items.summary_zh: 农业光伏（AV）系统将园艺作物与光伏（PV）基础设施结合在同一地块上，可在半干旱气候条件下为作物长势、发电量和用水效率带来互利效益。但半干旱地区的农业光伏系统是否能为土壤发育和碳（C）积累带来额外效益，目前尚不明确。 在半干旱地区，某些作物的农光系统已被观察到具有更高的地上部生物量和产量，这可能会通过促进更持续、更广泛的微生物和根系呼吸作用而加速碳损失，导致一个生长季内土壤碳的净变化为零或呈负值。 另一方面，AV系统也可能通过减少应激诱导的呼吸作用来保留更多的土壤碳。为了验证这些相互矛盾的假设，我们对比了在美国亚利桑那州南部一个实验性AV站点中种植的两种园艺作物的生物量和产量、土壤碳库，以及半连续微气候和二氧化碳（CO₂）排放量。 在一个夏季生长季内，我们观察到豆科作物 （牛豆，Vigna unguiculata）的日均土壤二氧化碳排放量减少了约9%，而芳香草本植物（罗勒，Ocimum basilicum）种植床的排放量则减少了48%，其中AV系统的影响在植物成熟的季风季节初期最为显著。 在昼夜时间尺度上，与传统园艺种植床相比，AV土壤二氧化碳通量在一天中的较晚时段达到峰值，这与太阳能电池板下土壤温度的滞后升高相吻合。 AV系统中较低的二氧化碳排放量恰与地上部作物生物量翻倍同时发生。在整个生长季节，无论是作物还是覆盖类型，土壤碳含量均呈现类似的下降趋势，这表明在此期间，二氧化碳排放量的减少并未对应土壤碳含量的可测量的增加，同时也突显了厘清其他碳转化和损失途径的必要性。 除了已广为人知的食物、水和能源方面的益处外，我们还发现AV在减少土壤二氧化碳释放方面具有潜力，并敦促未来的研究确定土壤碳含量的变化。

items.title: Increasing tropical forest fragmentation intensifies extreme high temperatures
items.title_en: Increasing tropical forest fragmentation intensifies extreme high temperatures
items.title_zh: 热带森林破碎化加剧导致极端高温现象加剧
items.summary_en: Deforestation, as one of the most pressing global environmental challenges, can intensify local temperature extremes through altering surface properties (e.g. albedo, roughness and evapotranspiration) and the associated land–atmosphere interactions. Prior studies have largely focused on the effects of forest cover changes at the grid scale, whereas the impact of subgrid-scale changes in forest fragmentation has received relatively limited attention. Utilizing satellite-based forest fragmentation index (FFI) data and the ERA5-Land reanalysis data, we investigate impacts of FFI changes in tropical forests on local extreme temperature indices, including the annual mean and maximum values of daily maximum temperature (TXm and TXx, respectively). Our results show that increasing FFI (i.e. forests becoming more fragmented) can significantly intensify extreme temperatures, with each unit increase in FFI corresponding to increases of 0.35 °C –1.14 °C for TXm and 0.83 °C –2.85 °C for TXx. These phenomena are mainly attributed to fragmentation-induced shifts in surface energy partitioning, which reduce latent heat flux and enhance sensible heating. The sensitivities of extreme temperatures to increasing FFI vary by region, with its strength being strongest in the Congo Basin (1.14 °C unit−1 for TXm and 2.85 °C unit−1 for TXx) but weaker in the Amazon basin (0.58 °C unit−1 for TXm and 1.21 °C unit−1 for TXx) and Southeast Asia (0.35 °C unit−1 for TXm and 0.83 °C unit−1 for TXx). These regional differences result from that background hydroclimatic conditions and land–atmosphere coupling strength can modulate the effect of forest fragmentation changes on extreme temperatures. These findings highlight the important role of increasing forest fragmentation in amplification of local temperature extremes, with implications for developing forest management strategies aimed at enhancing resilience to extreme climate events under ongoing warming.
items.summary_zh: 森林砍伐作为最紧迫的全球环境挑战之一，会通过改变地表特性（如反照率、粗糙度和蒸散量）以及相关的陆地-大气相互作用，加剧当地的极端气温。 先前的研究主要关注网格尺度上森林覆盖变化的影响，而亚网格尺度森林破碎化变化的影响则相对较少受到关注。 利用基于卫星的森林破碎化指数（FFI）数据和 ERA5-Land 再分析数据，我们研究了热带森林中 FFI 变化对当地极端温度指数的影响，包括日最高温度的年均值和最大值（分别表示为 TXm 和 TXx）。 研究结果表明，FFI的增加（即森林破碎化程度加深）会显著加剧极端温度，FFI每增加一个单位，TXm和TXx分别上升0.35 °C–1.14 °C和0.83 °C –2.85 °C。这些现象主要归因于森林破碎化导致的地表能量分配变化，这种变化会降低潜热通量并增强显热加热。 极端温度对 FFI 增加的敏感性因地区而异，其中刚果盆地最为显著（TXm 为 1.14 °C/单位，TXx 为 2.85 °C/单位），而亚马逊盆地 （TXm 为 0.58 °C/单位，TXx 为 1.21 °C/单位）以及东南亚（TXm 为 0.35 °C/单位，TXx 为 0.83 °C/单位）则较弱。 这些区域差异源于背景水文气候条件和陆地-大气耦合强度能够调节森林破碎化变化对极端温度的影响。这些发现凸显了森林破碎化加剧在放大局部温度极端事件中的重要作用，这对制定旨在增强在持续变暖背景下应对极端气候事件韧性的森林管理策略具有重要意义。
items.summary: 森林砍伐作为最紧迫的全球环境挑战之一，会通过改变地表特性（如反照率、粗糙度和蒸散量）以及相关的陆地-大气相互作用，加剧当地的极端气温。 先前的研究主要关注网格尺度上森林覆盖变化的影响，而亚网格尺度森林破碎化变化的影响则相对较少受到关注。 利用基于卫星的森林破碎化指数（FFI）数据和 ERA5-Land 再分析数据，我们研究了热带森林中 FFI 变化对当地极端温度指数的影响，包括日最高温度的年均值和最大值（分别表示为 TXm 和 TXx）。 研究结果表明，FFI的增加（即森林破碎化程度加深）会显著加剧极端温度，FFI每增加一个单位，TXm和TXx分别上升0.35 °C–1.14 °C和0.83 °C –2.85 °C。这些现象主要归因于森林破碎化导致的地表能量分配变化，这种变化会降低潜热通量并增强显热加热。 极端温度对 FFI 增加的敏感性因地区而异，其中刚果盆地最为显著（TXm 为 1.14 °C/单位，TXx 为 2.85 °C/单位），而亚马逊盆地 （TXm 为 0.58 °C/单位，TXx 为 1.21 °C/单位）以及东南亚（TXm 为 0.35 °C/单位，TXx 为 0.83 °C/单位）则较弱。 这些区域差异源于背景水文气候条件和陆地-大气耦合强度能够调节森林破碎化变化对极端温度的影响。这些发现凸显了森林破碎化加剧在放大局部温度极端事件中的重要作用，这对制定旨在增强在持续变暖背景下应对极端气候事件韧性的森林管理策略具有重要意义。

items.title: Alaska’s monster tsunami sent water 1,580 feet up a mountain
items.title_en: Alaska’s monster tsunami sent water 1,580 feet up a mountain
items.title_zh: 阿拉斯加那场巨型海啸将海水推上了1,580英尺高的山坡
items.summary_en: A massive landslide in Alaska triggered the second-highest tsunami ever recorded, sending water and debris 1,580 feet up a mountainside just hours after tourists visited the area. Scientists discovered that the disaster was preceded by several warning signs, including rapid glacier retreat, heavy rainfall, and thousands of tiny seismic tremors. As glaciers retreat, similar disasters could become a growing danger in mountainous coastal regions.
items.summary_zh: 阿拉斯加发生的一起大规模山体滑坡引发了有史以来记录到的第二高海啸，就在游客造访该地区仅数小时后，海啸将水流和碎石冲上了1,580英尺高的山坡。 科学家发现，这场灾难发生前曾出现过若干预警信号，包括冰川急速退缩、强降雨以及数千次微弱地震。随着冰川持续退缩，类似的灾难在山区沿海地区可能成为日益严峻的威胁。

items.title: Hurricane warning maps are improving, but a dangerous problem remains
items.title_en: Hurricane warning maps are improving, but a dangerous problem remains
items.title_zh: 飓风预警图虽在不断改进，但一个危险的问题依然存在
items.summary_en: A new study reveals that improved hurricane forecast graphics may help people identify threatened areas without making them more likely to recognize the danger or take protective action. Researchers also found that a widespread misunderstanding of the hurricane cone persists, highlighting a potentially dangerous gap between accurate forecasts and public preparedness.
items.summary_zh: 一项新研究表明，改进后的飓风预报图虽然有助于人们识别受威胁区域，但未必能提高他们对危险的认知或促使他们采取防护措施。研究人员还发现，人们对飓风锥的普遍误解依然存在，这凸显了准确预报与公众防灾准备之间存在潜在的危险差距。

items.title: Something strange is happening beneath a volcano near 2 million people
items.title_en: Something strange is happening beneath a volcano near 2 million people
items.title_zh: 在靠近200万人口的一座火山下方，正在发生一些奇怪的事情
items.summary_en: Scientists have discovered evidence of two hidden magma sources beneath Nicaragua’s Masaya volcano, where satellite observations revealed mysterious ground movements suggesting magma is shifting deep underground. The findings could improve eruption forecasting for the active volcano, which sits near 2 million people and attracts tourists to its spectacular lava lake.
items.summary_zh: 科学家们在尼加拉瓜马萨亚火山下方发现了两个隐蔽岩浆源的证据。此前，卫星观测显示该地区出现了神秘的地表运动，这表明地下深处有岩浆在移动。这一发现有望提高对这座活火山的喷发预测精度。该火山附近居住着近200万人，其壮观的熔岩湖也吸引了众多游客。
